author: Rinehart
text: AK, always examine your FLs under the smallest TF available.

author: Astrokillah
text:
Rinehart, you're the star! thank you so much!

And this gets to prove that the conventional wisdom of HTF elements beat
 LTF elements are probably wrong? I have seen that that LTF kink is
just as powerful as HTF kink. What I mean is that even if price coming
from HTF FL, it can hit a LTF FL, bounce and reverse big time to engulf
the HTF FL that price originally come from. Is this consistent with your
 observation too?

Rinehart wrote: AK, always examine your FLs under the smallest TF available.

author: Rinehart
text:
No, I think that way of thinking is too broad and will have newbies marking every 1 min kink even if they are trading on HTF.

It is our job to identify the important FLs AND THEN examine those FLs
with the smallest TF available to get the proper boundaries.

That FL was important because it looked like PA.

Here is my chart, I have explaint what I did in the chart.

1. In HTF, I see compression, and price later broke into this
compression and made the big kink which later becomes a LFL (blue
color), once price hit the orange zone.

2. A is blue FL's mouth FL and B is the MPL/Apex.

3. FL "A" is engulfed when price comes down from orange zone, so we can
say later it will go to FL B, which is the apex of Blue FL.

4. As we assumed, it goes to FL B. So the red Rectangle becomes the FL which is created after breaking the FL A.

5. FL C is the mouth FL and FL D is the Apex/MPL of the red FL.

6. Now we can see currently FL C is engulfed.

7. So we can assume price will go to FL D in future (FL D represents two MPLs - dotted rectangle and thick black rectangle)

By these I can conclude that, my previous trade was just a bounce. It
was not done after a proper price reading. I traded in a middle of a FL.
 Please correct If I am wrong.
